title: An immersion with closed image is a closed immersion
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be an immersion of schemes, i.e. $f=j\circ i$ with $i:X\to U$ a closed immersion and $j:U\to Y$ an open immersion onto an open subscheme $U\subseteq Y$ [def-weil-closed-immersion], [def-weil-open-immersion]. Then $f$ is a closed immersion if and only if its image $f(X)$ is a closed subset of $Y$.
